input.content:
🌊 Monterey Bay Guide
Activities Tide Tips About

Dive Into Monterey

Fun things to see and do along California's wild, kelp-fringed coast.

Explore the Bay ↓

Things to Do

Ride the current through our favorite Monterey experiences.

🐙

Monterey Bay Aquarium

Wander through swaying kelp forests, giant Pacific octopuses, and playful sea otters at one of the world's best aquariums.

World-Class
🦦

Otter & Sea Lion Spotting

Grab a coffee and watch wild sea otters and sea lions lounge along the Coast Guard Pier and Cannery Row.

Free
🐋

Whale Watching Cruise

Head out onto the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary to spot humpbacks, orcas, and migrating gray whales.

Seasonal
🚴

17-Mile Drive & Coastal Trail

Bike or drive the scenic Recreation Trail from Cannery Row to Pebble Beach, past cypress trees and crashing surf.

Scenic
🛶

Kayaking the Kelp Forest

Paddle out from the harbor to glide over kelp beds, harbor seals, and curious otters at eye level with the water.

Adventure
🎣

Old Fisherman's Wharf

Sample fresh clam chowder, watch fishing boats unload, and browse the historic wharf that built Monterey's seafaring legacy.

Foodie
🤿

Scuba Diving & Snorkeling

Explore some of California's clearest waters and dive sites teeming with kelp forest life, right off the point.

Adventure
🏛️

Cannery Row & History Walk

Stroll the street immortalized by John Steinbeck, once packed with sardine canneries, now shops and ocean views.

Culture
🌅

Sunset at Lovers Point

Catch golden-hour light over the bay from this Pacific Grove park, a favorite for tide pools and picnics.

Free

Tide Pool & Ocean Tips

🕒 Check the Tide Chart

Low tide reveals the best tide pools — anemones, sea stars, and hermit crabs — especially around Asilomar and Pacific Grove.

🧥 Layer Up

Monterey stays cool and foggy year-round. Bring a windbreaker even in summer — the bay breeze doesn't care about the season.

🐾 Give Wildlife Space

Otters, seals, and shorebirds are protected in the sanctuary. Admire from a distance and never feed wild animals.

Made with 🌊 for lovers of the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary.
